newsitem.title: FRANCE: Swisscargo drops cargo surcharge from Apr.
newsitem.headline: Swisscargo drops cargo surcharge from Apr.

text.p: Swisscargo said it is removing its fuel surcharge for all the air cargo it markets effective April 15.
The Swiss airline imposed a surcharge of 15 Swiss centimes equivalent to 10 US cents a kilo effective November 15 last year in the face of soaring jet fuel prices.
Swisscargo said it is dropping the surcharge as the price of jet kerosene has fallen to 74.01 U.S. cents a U.S. gallon or the same level as last July.
Swisscargo markets the freight capacity of Swissair, Balair/CTA, Crossair, Sabena, Sobelair and CityBird with a total of 107 destinations.
Earlier on Friday KLM said its surcharges on all routes are been dropped rom April 15 and Cathay Pacific said its surcharges on flights from the UK will be removed effective May 1.
On Thursday Lufthansa the world's largest international freight carrier said it was scrapping fuel surcharges effective April 15. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
